summary: Tested picture-preview share links and the editable copy header. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass. /convert/bulk returns an 8-char share_code. /go/{code} and /go/d/{id} return HTML with og:title/og:description/og:image and location.replace() to the affiliate link, and 404 for unknown ids. Settings copy_header/copy_link_style work (empty header persists; an invalid style returns 422). Flipkart converts to fkrt.site through Sankmo. Frontend: 'Copy all' with 1 and 2 links puts the header first, then Deal Price/MRP/Store blocks with '<BACKEND_URL>/api/go/<code>' links. TEST HEADER, direct style (fkrt.site/amazon links) and empty header (no header line) all work. The deals page copy uses /api/go/d/{id}. The per-link buttons don't crash. One real UI bug: the Copy settings panel shows stale default values after a page load.

minor.issue: Flipkart URLs without a pid (e.g. /tommy-hilfiger-.../p/itm2f049aec7e6b6) get title/image/price = null, because pricehistory misses them and Flipkart blocks the og:image fetch. Those /go/ pages have no og:image, so the user's main ask (a picture in Telegram) fails for such links. Consider resolving the image from the converted fkrt link, or from the Flipkart page with a better UA, or letting the user paste an image URL.
Amazon title contains an HTML entity that is not decoded: 'Parachute Advansed Protein Shampoo with Coconut Milk &amp'. Run html.unescape on scraped titles.

ui_bugs.issue: useState(prefs.header)/useState(prefs.style) is set once at mount. On direct load of /admin, Convert Links is the default tab, so it mounts before App's async loadPrefs() resolves. Repro: PUT settings copy_header='X CUSTOM', style='direct', then load /admin: the input shows the default '🪙 100% SuperCoin Deals 🪙' and 'preview' is highlighted. Copying still uses the right prefs, but if the user clicks a style button or Save, the stale header is sent and their custom header is OVERWRITTEN. Fix: fetch /settings in CopySettings on mount (useEffect → setHeader/setStyle), or await loadPrefs before rendering.

action_items: Sync CopySettings state with server settings after load (useEffect fetch of /api/settings), so a stale default header doesn't overwrite the user's custom one
html.unescape scraped titles in deal_info / ph data (&amp shows in copied text and og:title)
Improve image lookup for Flipkart links that have no pid, so preview pages have og:image
critical_code_review_comments: preview_html: og:image uses third-party image URLs (images.price.tools, m.media-amazon). That works for Telegram, but consider routing through /api/image-proxy as a fallback for hosts that block hotlinking
db.links grows with every bulk convert (a new code each time, even for the same URL) and has no index on 'code'. Add an index and/or dedupe by url
/api/go/* pages are served from the preview domain with x-robots-tag noindex. Fine for previews, but check that production uses the deployed domain

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all copy/share flows pass; settings panel shows stale state on load)

seed_data_creation: Bulk converts created several db.links docs (share codes). Settings restored to copy_header='🪙 100% SuperCoin Deals 🪙', copy_link_style='preview'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sankmo is connected: real Flipkart URLs convert to fkrt.site in about 5-10s. A good test URL with image/price: https://www.flipkart.com/flipkart/p/itm69cc6d7c2842e?pid=WATG4NP8QGQNZGGH. amazon_tag is '' so Amazon shows 'Add your Amazon tag first' but still gets a share_code. Grant clipboard-read/write in playwright and read with navigator.clipboard.readText(). To retest the CopySettings bug: PUT a custom header via the API, load /admin directly and check the copy-header-input value. Restore defaults after.
